info.title: Kiroku API
info.description: REST API for Kiroku Institutional Repository. Manages academic works (theses, dissertations, journals) with community/collection/item hierarchy, full-text search, SWORD v2 deposit, and OAI-PMH harvesting.

get.description: Container liveness/readiness probe. Returns status ok.

Returns all active communities visible to the authenticated user. Serves an ETag; conditional requests (If-None-Match) return 304. The flattened list now carries `parent_community_id` for tree navigation; subcommunities route available at /communities/{id}/subcommunities.

get.description: Returns a single collection with item count and parent community.

Search and list published items with pagination, filters, sorting and alphabetical browsing.

Search semantics: `q` is matched as AND-of-tokens via `plainto_tsquery('indonesian', q)` over the generated `search_vector` (title, abstract, title_alt, abstract_alt, student_name, subject_classification, department, faculty, program_study, extracted PDF text) plus token matches on author names and keywords. With `q` present the default ordering is relevance (ts_rank); without `q`, results are ordered published_at DESC.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. relevance (default, only meaningful with q), published_at, title, author, subject

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction; default desc for relevance/published_at, asc for title/author/subject

parameters.name: starts_with
parameters.description: Alphabetical prefix browse applied to the current sort field (title by default; author with sort=author; subject with sort=subject). Case-insensitive.

200.description: Search results. The `X-Total-Count` header mirrors meta.total_count.

X-Total-Count.description: Grand total of matching published items

post.summary: Full deposit (binary upload or URL link mode)
post.description:
Create item with relations and files in a single request. Supports two modes:

**Mode 1: Binary file upload (multipart/form-data)** — files uploaded as form parts.

**Mode 2: URL link mode (application/json)** — files referenced by URL with `deposit_type: "link"`.

files[chapters].description: Chapter PDF files (multiple allowed, max 50 MB each)

get.description: List accessible bitstreams (files) for an item.

post.description: Upload a file to an item via multipart/form-data.

get.description: Streams the file bytes. Supports random access: requests with a `Range: bytes=a-b` header return 206 + Content-Range; responses always carry Accept-Ranges: bytes and an ETag. Item may be addressed by UUID or handle. Access is enforced per file (bundle/embargo/access_level): denied files get a 403 in the error envelope.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: RFC 9110 single byte range, e.g. bytes=0- at reader open or bytes=1048576- for random-access pages

get.description: Serves the stored THUMBNAIL bitstream bytes (always publicly accessible per bundle rules). `size` is reserved for future variants — the stored thumbnail is served regardless.

Source of truth for kiosk device state. A deleted/rotated device token yields 401 (kiosk maps to revoked). Device tokens without approval read state needs_reverify. Policies/announcement/contact are admin-editable.

post.description: Accepts up to 500 visitor events per request. Idempotent per (sessionId, type, timestamp) — a replayed buffer is not double-counted; `accepted` reports newly inserted rows.

get.description: Returns an APP Service Document listing all communities (workspaces) and their collections (Col-IRIs).

application/atomserv+xml.example:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<service xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2007/app" xmlns:sword="http://purl.org/sword/2/">
  <workspace>
    <title>Fakultas Teknik</title>
    <collection href="http://localhost:4000/sword-v2/collection/ft-ti">
      <title>Teknik Informatika</title>
      <accepts>application/atom+xml</accepts>
      <accepts>multipart/related</accepts>
    </collection>
  </workspace>
</service>

post.description: Deposit an item into a collection. Accepts Atom XML (metadata only) or multipart/related (metadata + file).

application/atom+xml.example:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<entry xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:dcterms="http://purl.org/dc/terms/">
  <title>Implementasi Deep Learning</title>
  <dcterms:abstract>Penelitian ini membahas...</dcterms:abstract>
  <dcterms:type>skripsi</dcterms:type>
  <dcterms:creator>Ahmad Rizki</dcterms:creator>
</entry>

get.description: Returns a SWORD v2 Statement describing the item's lifecycle state.
OAI-PMH 2.0 harvesting endpoint. Supports verbs: Identify, ListMetadataFormats, ListSets, ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, GetRecord.

parameters.name: metadataPrefix
parameters.description: Metadata format prefix (required for ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, GetRecord)

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Item identifier (required for GetRecord). Format: oai:kiroku.ac.id:<uuid>

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Set specification filter. Format: com_<community_id> or col_<collection_id>

bearerAuth.description: Kiroku API token. Format: kiroku_<base64>. Supply via Authorization: Bearer <token> header or ?token=<token> query parameter.

example.message: Missing or invalid API token. Supply it via the Authorization: Bearer <token> header or the ?token=<token> query parameter.

RangeNotSatisfiable.description: Requested Range header is not satisfiable

ErrorResponse.description: Uniform error envelope for all non-2xx responses: machinery-parsable code + human message.

error.description: Machine code, e.g. not_found, forbidden, validation_error, unauthorized

parent_community_id.description: Direct parent community (adjacency-list hierarchy); null for roots
